csv_agency: State of Tennessee Department of General Services
csv_scope_of_work: Construction of office, service centers and helipad, training, housing and support bldgs; driver training track and related structures; firing ranges; campus infrastructure; relocation of a monument; bldg demolition; wetland remediation; and related work. Project includes design of an office and warehousing facility for the Tennessee Department of Corrections to house inmate records, electronics security, radio and key control, fleet management, and investigations and interdiction units that are currently housed in other locations, including temporary facilities. The new facility will be required to be designed for expansion for other operations elements that may move to this location in the future. Facility will also require the demolition of the existing maintenance building and associated site amenities.
